Outcome table (tries from the first state, each in order a, b, c, stop at the first panic): panic = bootreason kernel_panic, back on Android a in ~75 s; no panic = phone returns by itself at ~120 s with bootreason reboot. First panic at 5a: configfs mount or gadget dir creation; at 5b: the ncm function or config; at 5c: the UDC bind (the dwc3 controller) or the network/telnetd part. 5c without a panic: the gadget is up and gadget-up.sh (read-only ping/telnet to 172.16.43.1) can pass during the 120 s. No hands expected in any outcome: the init returns by itself, a panic falls back by itself.
considered: one script for all three (a loop), one init file per step so each image's source is readable alone
rejected: a single image with a step chosen at run time (no way to pass it: the kernel command line is the control's and must stay)
